_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Headless History#000.src: Talk to Hans in the {p} outskirts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#001.src: Oi, you there! With the small nose and whatnot! I got somethin' to ask you. Got a minute?
A Headless History#001.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#002.src: Good, you're good people. It's about our neighbor, Referick. He's a bit of a conspiracy nut. You know the type, villager illuminati, Wybels are evil, all that?
A Headless History#002.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#003.src: He's acting proper strange though, the past few days. Thinkin' a lord of time's draggin' creatures from other dimensions doesn't make ya stop eatin' or drinkin'.
A Headless History#003.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#004.src: He'll talk your ear off about it if you give him half a chance, but he ain't sayin' a word to me, even when I tried askin' about his theories.
A Headless History#004.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#005.src: Somethin's definitely wrong about him, that much's for sure. Could ya take a look for me, see whatcha can figure out and all?
A Headless History#005.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#006.src: He lives in the house next to the pile of rocks. He's got screws loose but I don't want 'im dyin' on me, yeah?
A Headless History#006.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#007.src: Talk to Referick in his house and head upstairs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#009.src: Oi! Any luck with ol' Rick there?
A Headless History#009.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#010.src: ...hm. Dang it...y'know, maybe there's somethin' here that'll tell us what in heck happened.
A Headless History#010.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#011.src: Let's look around the house for anythin' he mighta been workin' on. Maybe he finally fiddled with somethin' he shouldn'ta fiddled with?
A Headless History#011.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#012.src: Investigate his house for clues as to what could have happened.

A Headless History#013.src: Whassat you're lookin' at there? The castle? Don't see why he'd be pointin' this ol' telescope that way.
A Headless History#013.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#014.src: You're human, so you wouldn't know, but somethin' like two hundred years ago, an elf of all people lived in that castle. Called 'imself Dullahan, wore a helmet a lot, I think.
A Headless History#014.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#015.src: People thought he was the reason for the Decay- can't imagine why, personally, and obviously they weren't right.
A Headless History#015.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#016.src: ...hm. Y'know, there's some ghost stories about Dullahan still livin' in that castle... Come to think of it, I think Referick mentioned a theory about it.
A Headless History#016.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#017.src: Barely remember what it was about cause of how many crackpots he's stuck his head into, but it's somethin' about a ghost. 's the only lead I can think of, anyways...
A Headless History#017.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#018.src: The castle door's locked, but you can access the basement. Think you could try lookin' over there? That's all I got.
A Headless History#018.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#019.src: Travel to the castle in the north at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#021.src: ...an unfamiliar soul? Strange. I have not brought you here. I do not know of you.

A Headless History#022.src: What an odd feeling... I haven't felt confusion in a long time. How refreshing...still, I shall ask you to leave.

A Headless History#023.src: Excuse you. I asked you to leave, strange person. You would ignore my request?

A Headless History#024.src: Such an action is rather insolent, not to mention...interesting. Still, interfering with my business is inexcusable.

A Headless History#025.src: Demons of the Prison Guard, I compel you to execute this interloper. Trap their soul for my perusal later.

A Headless History#026.src: Return to Referick with his soul at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#027.src: OI! Referick!! Wait for me! Ain'tcha need some food and drink first?!
A Headless History#027.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#028.src: The heck did you do?! Referick just bolted out the door like he forgot his wallet or somethin'!
A Headless History#028.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#030.src: C'mon mate, you got up and moved for the first time in days and now you're clammin' up again? Speak to me!
A Headless History#030.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#032.src: YIPE! Never heard 'im scream like that before! Never heard anyone scream like that before! I'd like to never hear anyone scream like that again!
A Headless History#032.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#033.src: Oh, shut UP Hans! I nearly had my soul devoured, don't DARE give me any chaff when I was RIGHT all along!!
A Headless History#033.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#034.src: Agh, alright, alright! Quiet, my ears are ringin'! I'll listen, I'll listen, just quiet!
A Headless History#034.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#035.src: I knew the disappearances in {p} weren't just because of the risen bodies. People were being left catatonic!! That doesn't happen randomly!
A Headless History#035.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#036.src: It's Dullahan, I swear on my life! I figured him out and he came after me! He's devouring peoples' souls and siphoning their energy for himself!
A Headless History#036.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#037.src: He's acting from within the castle somehow- Ghostly hands and servants, I'll bet! And that means there's a chance to stop him, if he has to act indirectly!
A Headless History#037.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#038.src: We need to round up the townsfolk, the guards, the military, EVERYONE! We have to storm the castle and stop him before he's able to escape!
A Headless History#038.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#039.src: ...criminy, you really bit the big one, didn'tcha...look, if he's tryin' to eat people's souls, wouldn't it be smarter to NOT have a huge mob?
A Headless History#039.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#040.src: Wait, wh-what do you mean?! Shouldn't everyone be on high alert? Won't we have a better chance of swarming him all at once?
A Headless History#040.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#041.src: He'd have a whole mob of people ready to take from in that case. Sending in one, heavily-armed person, or a small group'd be better.
A Headless History#041.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#042.src: And, well...a heavily-armed human just rescued ya, Ricky. I think we leave this to 'em. How about it, human? Head up to the castle and look into this for us?
A Headless History#042.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#044.src: The interesting soul arrives once more. Why is it you valued the life of that villager? You risked yourself for his soul.

A Headless History#045.src: It will not make a difference one way or the other, and so I am doubly confused. The feeling has already grown tiresome.

A Headless History#046.src: What purpose have you in this place? Turn over your soul so I may examine it and find out. I am genuinely curious to know...

A Headless History#048.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#048.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#050.src: LARIII! Where are you?! I can help!!
A Headless History#050.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#051.src: Ugh, I saw her with that...THING, but...
A Headless History#051.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#052.src: My visions didn't show an exact enough spot... LARIII?
A Headless History#052.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#053.src: I...what is... What left the land scarred like this?!
A Headless History#053.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#054.src: Was...was this their clash...? L-LARI! LARIIII! WHERE ARE YOU?!
A Headless History#054.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#056.src: You are NOT dying on me! I won't allow it! You will LIVE, you hear me?!
A Headless History#056.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#057.src: Sit as still as you can, I have healing spells prepared.
A Headless History#057.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#058.src: I ask the land for its life to save another. Grant me this!
A Headless History#058.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#060.src: Oh, what am I going to do with you...
A Headless History#060.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#062.src: Once again you ignore my demands...? And not only that, you invade the memories I have locked away?
A Headless History#062.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#063.src: I must ask again, what is your goal? Why have you come here, and why do you seek my most private thoughts, that not even I wish to think?
A Headless History#063.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#064.src: Look, Dulla, I really do appreciate your help, but you know I can't do what you're asking of me! There's another way, I just need to find it!
A Headless History#064.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#065.src: Lari, you remember that I have my visions, right? I've seen what will happen if you don't step up- and I can help stop it!
A Headless History#065.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#066.src: You've been trying to find "anotherway" for two centuries. Don't you think it's high-time we took my route, before things get worse?
A Headless History#066.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#067.src: NO! I am not going to kill it! YOU are not going to kill it! I'll find a way! I will, I have these powers for a reason!
A Headless History#067.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#068.src: You talk a big game, and you show one too, but the creature wasn't fazed. I'm not fazed. Drop the intimidating act, please.
A Headless History#068.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#069.src: I...there...there has to be a way. I...I-I'm terrified that I've...already ruined everything, just by following my heart, like I was told...
A Headless History#069.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#070.src: I know you're frustrated, but I am too. I left a lot behind to try and help you. I hate to say these things, I wish it could be your way.
A Headless History#070.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#071.src: I'm terrified too, that if we don't take more drastic action, things will get worse. Can't you see that, too?
A Headless History#071.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#072.src: I...I just... I don't know what to do!
A Headless History#072.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#073.src: He showed me all these things and gave me all these choices and asked how my heart beat!
A Headless History#073.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#074.src: He gave me these powers but they don't work or I don't know HOW they work!
A Headless History#074.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#075.src: I want to do the right thing but I don't know what it is and I don't know how to ask what it is and...a-and...
A Headless History#075.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#076.src: You have become infuriating instead of interesting. Why do you violate my memories? Why do you force me to relive them?
A Headless History#076.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#077.src: Spirit of the Keeper of Keys, rid me of this thing that befouls my place. It incites a rage akin to HER.
A Headless History#077.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#078.src: You...are a fool. More than I was. You knowingly walk to your death.
A Headless History#078.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#079.src: It is convenient for me, certainly, but I admit that it is equal parts enraging and bewildering.
A Headless History#079.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#080.src: Leave the room and continue exploring the castle.

A Headless History#081.src: I told you, Lari! I saw it in my visions, this is our last chance! Hurry!
A Headless History#081.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#082.src: Look at this spot, Lari. It has to be here. The land is being scarred, just like after your fight. The light is being drained!
A Headless History#082.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#083.src: This must be where the parasite burrowed down... You're... You're right. We have to...to do something.
A Headless History#083.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#084.src: I... I'm not sure if I'm ready, but you're right. We need to do this...
A Headless History#084.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#085.src: ...Remember what I said. You HAVE to take action. There's only two outcomes here.
A Headless History#085.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#087.src: We'll need to dig... Do you think you could help with that, Dulla?
A Headless History#087.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#088.src: Of course, Lari. We'll need everything we can get if we're going to kill that horrendous thing.
A Headless History#088.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#090.src: I see it! Lari, it's time!
A Headless History#090.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#091.src: ...I will show you an exit, interloper. It would be...wise of you to take it.
A Headless History#091.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#092.src: You are a damned fool, interloper. Dredging my memories as you have... I have never felt such rage, not in a long time.
A Headless History#092.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#093.src: As such, it shall end now. The exit I spoke of will not free you from the castle, as you can see.
A Headless History#093.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#094.src: Warden of Wisdom! I compel you- Rid me of this miscreant! Erase every trace of it from this existence...
A Headless History#094.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#095.src: ...save for a corpse, for me to toss at Lari's feet.
A Headless History#095.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#096.src: GAH! It was never able to do this before...! W-What happened to it?!
A Headless History#096.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#097.src: AWAY! You keep away from us!!
A Headless History#097.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#098.src: Lari, you need to get up, now! We can't waste this chance!
A Headless History#098.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#099.src: It...it threw me aside like nothing! How is it overpowering Orphion's light...?
A Headless History#099.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#100.src: It's overpowering you because you're not attacking! Remember what I said? You have to-
A Headless History#100.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#101.src: ...wait, where did it...did we lose it already?!
A Headless History#101.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#103.src: It's shrugging my attacks off, Lari! Come on, do SOMETHING!
A Headless History#103.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#105.src: I...No! It's happening just like I saw! She's...
A Headless History#105.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#106.src: I need to get to her, push her to the killing blow...
A Headless History#106.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#107.src: Be still, creature! I compel you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#107.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#108.src: LARIIII! THIS IS THE LAST CHANCE YOU HAVE! DON'T TRAP IT, KILL IT!
A Headless History#108.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#109.src: I-I'm...Dulla, I'm- I can't! I know I can keep it held this time!!
A Headless History#109.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#111.src: I...I-I...th-the light is...I c-can't hold onto it...i-is it...it's t-taking...g-guh...
A Headless History#111.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#112.src: Lari! You can't reason with it! You can't hold it! You have to put Gavel first! US first!!
A Headless History#112.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#113.src: I won't let what you predicted happen! I know I can change fate!!
A Headless History#113.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#114.src: Please work, please work! D-Don't break, I can't-
A Headless History#114.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#115.src: Lari, no! If it bites you we're doomed! GET UP!
A Headless History#115.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#118.src: L-Lari...we...e-everything happened like I s-said...you...you didn't...l-listen...
A Headless History#118.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#119.src: No! No it didn't happen like you said! I-I can fix this! Y-You'll be alright! You'll be alright, you hear me?! I'll make sure of it!
A Headless History#119.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#120.src: ...so I am cursed to bear witness to my most painful memories due to your idiocy. It is almost a fitting penance... Almost, but not quite.
A Headless History#120.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#122.src: My rage... My memories... Your presence stirs them in kind. You must disappear, I no longer care to see your soul.
A Headless History#122.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#123.src: Sit still and allow yourself to be engulfed. It will save me further pain.
A Headless History#123.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#124.src: Lari...? Where are you? I...I need you... Why are you gone? Why do you ignore me?
A Headless History#124.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#125.src: My magic is fading, I can't see my visions... They're clearer around you... Please, come back...
A Headless History#125.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#126.src: That elf girl's off in the forest. Don't know what she's doing but this is our shot!
A Headless History#126.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#127.src: We can finally execute the person causing the decay in the forest! {p} will be saved!
A Headless History#127.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#128.src: You prepared the sleeping spell, right? Who knows if we'll get a chance like this again.
A Headless History#128.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#131.src: L-Lari? Is...is that you? Did you finally come back...?
A Headless History#131.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#132.src: Nah, not quite. Say, why don't you go to sleep 'til she comes back? Dream sweet dreams...
A Headless History#132.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#133.src: ...they'll be the last ones you ever have, grimy demon. To the guillotine with you... Everyone! I got him!
A Headless History#133.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#134.src: Everyone, welcome! Today will be the day we save our fair land. Today's the day of light!
A Headless History#134.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#135.src: Dullahan has been captured! We have the cursed progenitor of the decay in our grip- to be executed, once and for all!
A Headless History#135.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#136.src: Haha, yeah! Shoulda thought twice before cursing OUR homes! Three cheers for our wizards!!
A Headless History#136.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#137.src: The decay will clear up- We'll spill his blood, chop off his head, and the curse will be lifted!!
A Headless History#137.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#138.src: Ladies and gentlemen, folks of all shapes and sizes, it's time to take our lives back!
A Headless History#138.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#142.src: Dullahan? I'm...I'm back. I didn't leave you for long, I just was trying to find the cu-
A Headless History#142.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#143.src: ...uh? Dullahan? He's...he's been right here to greet me almost every day for the past twenty years...
A Headless History#143.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#144.src: Footprints...? Dullaaaa? Where'd you go? Is everything alright, did something happen?
A Headless History#144.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#147.src: I...I l-left for...an hour, a-and...and they... Why?
A Headless History#147.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#148.src: Why did they do this to you...? I...h-how can I possibly fix this?!
A Headless History#148.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#149.src: I cannot understand why you continue to defile me with these horrid memories. What do you hope to find?
A Headless History#149.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#150.src: I am once more curious. If only to know what I could possibly do or say to cease this horrid quest you've given yourself.
A Headless History#150.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#151.src: Th-this has to work. It WILL work! I know it will! I...I d-don't know if it will... I have to fix this, I have to...
A Headless History#151.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#152.src: The waters from the Lazarus Pit are fabled for bringing back the dead... If this doesn't work, I...
A Headless History#152.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#153.src: I can't think about that. This...this WILL work. I promise. I found a way to fix it... It has to.
A Headless History#153.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#154.src: P-Please...w-whatever gods are out there, whoever is listening, hear me...bring Dullahan back to me, I'm begging you...
A Headless History#154.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#155.src: It's... I-Is it reacting? It... It looks like it is, but...h-he's not mending...
A Headless History#155.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#156.src: N-No, this...i-it isn't...NO! It... It HAS to work! I...I can m-make this work!
A Headless History#156.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#159.src: I...I t-told you... I knew I could change fate... I'm so glad you're here...
A Headless History#159.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#160.src: It's odd. If it were not for her, I would not be here. I would not have my power. Yet even thinking her name enrages me.
A Headless History#160.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#161.src: Enter the last door in the dining hall.

A Headless History#163.src: H...h-hrk...g-gah, what is...wh-what... You...you didn't really...?
A Headless History#163.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#164.src: Th-there's so much death... The...the air smells like b-blood...
A Headless History#164.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#165.src: This isn't... There has to be s-some other reason, I... I can't have b-brought back a...a...
A Headless History#165.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#166.src: P-Please, we can't afford to lose more people! There's hardly any farmers in the fields anymore, I-I'm needed elsewhere!
A Headless History#166.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#167.src: The last few said similar things. Someone else I knew said similar things. Frankly, I do not care. Present your soul to me, now.
A Headless History#167.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#168.src: DULLAHAN! What...w-what are you doing?! I... I can't believe my eyes...
A Headless History#168.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#169.src: I... I tried to help you! I t-tried so hard at everything we did together... How could you do this to them?! To...to me?
A Headless History#169.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#170.src: Odd. I recall you explicitly denying the only option that would have prevented this. I warned you quite thoroughly.
A Headless History#170.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#171.src: You have had many chances to end this, Lari. Do you expect me to feel sympathy, when your own actions have made me feel nothing?
A Headless History#171.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#172.src: This...this isn't like you... You would never have done this before! You dedicated your life to trying to help...so w-why are you...m...m-m... I-I'm leaving!!
A Headless History#172.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#173.src: What have I done...? This...he's... He's not th-the same anymore... What changed? Is this my fault...? I c-can't understand it...
A Headless History#173.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#174.src: ...but...I'll... I'll protect them. I'll protect him... I...there has to be a way. But...until I find it...
A Headless History#174.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#175.src: ...goodbye. Goodbye until the day comes when I can fill you with light once more. Goodbye until you learn... Goodbye, until I can fix you...
A Headless History#175.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#177.src: Investigate the dark door at the end of the castle.
